package consumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/examples/article/models"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/query"
)

var newInsertPlanReturningKey func(string, []query.Assignment, query.FieldRef) query.InsertPlan =
	query.NewInsertPlanReturningKey

func ReturnedInsertKey() (query.FieldRef, bool) {
	plan := newInsertPlanReturningKey(
		"news_article",
		nil,
		query.NewFieldRef("id", "id", query.FieldInteger, false),
	)
	return plan.ReturningKey()
}

func WriteArticle(ctx context.Context, backend db.Mutator) error {
	created, err := models.ArticleObjects.Create(
		ctx,
		backend,
		models.NewArticleCreate("Created").WithPublished(false).WithSummary(""),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	updated, err := models.ArticleObjects.Patch(
		ctx,
		backend,
		created,
		models.ArticlePatch{}.WithSummaryNull(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = models.ArticleObjects.Delete(ctx, backend, &updated)
	return err
}

// A Boolean reference is valid as a same-kind assignment operand. Arithmetic
// remains a separate numeric capability checked by the negative fixture.
func UpdatePublished(ctx context.Context, backend db.Queryer) (int64, error) {
	return models.ArticleObjects.Using(backend).Update(ctx,
		orm.AssignExpression(models.ArticleFields.Published, orm.F(models.ArticleFields.Published)))
}

func WriteArticleAtomically(ctx context.Context, backend interface {
	db.Mutator
	db.Atomic
}) error {
	return backend.Atomic(ctx, func(session db.Session) error {
		_, err := models.ArticleObjects.Create(ctx, session, models.NewArticleCreate("Atomic"))
		return err
	})
}
